messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Deploy application with large depending libraries
parts:
Hi all,
I am now trying to deploy an application on shinyapps.io. The application requires large data libraries from Bioconductor (three libraries, each of size around 300 MB). When deploying the application, the "deployApp" function gives the following error. I have tried "myconfigureApp" function but the problem is that the application should be first uploaded before you can even use the function. Does anyone has similar problems?

Uploading application bundle...DONE
